usageNotes: Used by VNC proxy services to verify a short-lived VNC ticket issued during console session setup before allowing the WebSocket/TCP connection to proceed. The ticket, issuing user (authid), resource path, and required privileges must all match for validation to succeed. This is a server-side handshake call — clients do not call it directly; it is invoked by the noVNC/SPICE proxy internally after the ticket is generated via the node-level VNC console endpoints.

examples.summary: Verify a VNC ticket for a user accessing the console of VM 100

tips: VNC tickets are time-limited (typically ~2 minutes); verification must occur promptly after ticket issuance.
The 'path' and 'privs' fields mirror those checked when the ticket was originally generated — mismatches cause rejection even with a valid ticket.
Returns null on success; any non-2xx response indicates an invalid or expired ticket.
Port verification (the 'port' param) is optional but recommended to prevent ticket reuse on a different port.
